question: What happens if I miss an end-semester exam because I was ill?
answer: If you are unable to appear for an end-semester examination due to illness, you must submit a medical certificate issued by a registered medical practitioner and countersigned by the Institute Medical Officer to the Controller of Examinations within five working days of the exam date. Once the certificate is accepted, you will be permitted to take the course in the next supplementary examination, which will be treated as your first attempt and will be exempt from the supplementary examination fee.

question: What is the penalty if I am caught with a mobile phone in the exam hall?
answer: If you are caught with a mobile phone in the examination hall, it is treated as a first offence, even if the phone is switched off [EE §4.2]. For a first offence, the examination in the course concerned shall be cancelled and you shall be awarded the grade F in that course [EE §4.2].

question: What time do the hostel gates close at night?
answer: The hostel gates close at 10:30 p.m. every day. If you return after the gates have closed, you must sign the late-entry register maintained by the security staff and provide a reason for your delay.

question: Can I use an induction cooktop in my hostel room?
answer: No, you cannot use an induction cooktop in your hostel room. The use of induction cooktops in hostel rooms is prohibited, and such appliances will be confiscated with a fine of Rs. 1,000 imposed for each occurrence.

question: How much is the late fee if I pay my semester fees after the due date?
answer: If you pay your fees after the due date, a late fee of Rs. 100 per day is charged, up to and including the last date shown in Section 2.1. This late fee is capped at Rs. 1,500 for any single payment.

answer: You are eligible for the Merit-cum-Means Scholarship if your annual family income from all sources does not exceed Rs. 3,00,000. question: Do I get leave if there is a death in my family?

question: What is the maximum time allowed to complete the B.Tech programme?
answer: You must complete all requirements of the B.Tech. programme within a maximum period of seven academic years from the date of your first admission. If you fail to do so, your name shall be removed from the rolls of the Institute.

question: Can I get a mess rebate if I go home for two weeks?
answer: Yes, you are entitled to a rebate of mess charges if you are absent from the hostel for a continuous period of seven days or more. To receive this, you must record your absence in the leave register in advance and submit the rebate form within seven days of your return.

question: How much medical insurance cover do students have?
answer: You are covered under the Institute's group medical insurance scheme for hospitalisation expenses up to Rs. 1,00,000 per year. The premium for this coverage is included in your development fee.

question: What is the lowest attendance percentage that can still be condoned on medical grounds?
answer: There is a conflict regarding the minimum attendance required for condonation on medical grounds. [LM §2.2] states that condonation may be granted provided that the student's overall attendance in the course is not less than 55 per cent, whereas [AR §4.3] states that attendance must not be less than 65 per cent and that any shortage below 65 per cent shall not be condoned under any circumstances.

question: If I withdraw my admission before classes begin, how much of my tuition fee will be refunded?
answer: There is a conflict regarding your refund amount. [SF §6.2] states you shall be refunded the tuition fee paid after a deduction of a ten per cent processing charge, whereas [FS §4.1] states you shall be refunded 100 per cent of the tuition fee if you withdraw before the commencement of classes.

question: What CGPA do I need to maintain to keep my merit scholarship?
answer: [AR §11.2] states that a Merit Scholarship continues if you maintain a CGPA of "not less than 7.5 at the end of each semester," whereas [SF §3.1] states it continues "only if the student maintains a CGPA of not less than 8.0 at the end of each semester."
